note.value:
Initial Setup: The Skaven Warlord crews his ships using the free Slaves, Clanrats & Storm Vermin at the start of the game. Each squadron must have the same crew type. Cross out any crew not used.

Morale: A Skaven ship that takes a critical hit rolls on the following table:
0-1: Wide Scale Panic - remove d6 crew
2: Major panic - remove 2 crew
3: Minor panic - remove 1 crew
4-8: No problem!

Morale Modifiers: Doombringer +1, Slaves -1, Storm Vermin +1
